title: feat(core)!: score task outputs, carry logprobs and report KL

req_statements.R1: The `Scorer` port shall score one task output at a time: `score(*, task: Task, output: TaskOutput) -> Score`. The signature is keyword-only, references only core types, keeps the `metric: str` attribute, and replaces the `record: RunRecord` signature. The scorer returns one score per successful output; replicate aggregation stays outside the core.
req_statements.R2: The core shall expose two frozen value types for next-token probabilities: `TokenAlternative` with `token: str` and `logprob: float`, and `TokenLogprob` with `token: str`, `logprob: float` and `top_logprobs: tuple[TokenAlternative, ...] = ()`. Both shall validate that the token is non-empty and the log-probability is finite and `<= 0`. `TokenLogprob` shall reject duplicate alternative token strings; the generated token may also appear in `top_logprobs`, and the order is preserved.
req_statements.R3: `TaskOutput` shall carry an optional `logprobs: tuple[TokenLogprob, ...] | None = None`. `None` means log-probabilities were not requested; an empty tuple means they were requested but the engine returned no generated tokens. The field is additive and does not change `RunRecord` or the JSONL format.
req_statements.R4: The core shall expose a frozen `TaskKL` type with `task_id: str`, `divergence: float`, `reference_mass: float` and `variant_mass: float`. `task_id` shall be non-empty, `divergence` finite and `>= 0`, and both masses finite in `[0, 1]`. The type carries the result of one KL estimate and the probability mass that the estimate retained on each side.
req_statements.R5: `Report` shall carry three additive fields: `kl_divergence: float | None = None`, `task_kl: tuple[TaskKL, ...] = ()` and `kl_method: str | None = None`. They shall be all-or-nothing: either all absent/empty, or `task_kl` non-empty, `kl_divergence` finite and `>= 0`, and `kl_method` non-empty. `task_kl` task ids shall be unique and each shall exist in `deltas`; `kl_divergence` shall equal the arithmetic mean of the `TaskKL.divergence` values within an absolute tolerance of `1e-9`. A report with no KL fields shall remain valid.
req_statements.R6: The serialized schema shall stay version `"1"`. A pre-feature `Report` JSON without the KL fields shall parse with the defaults; a new `Report` with KL fields shall round-trip through `to_json`/`from_json` unchanged; unknown fields shall still be rejected; `RunRecord`, `to_jsonl` and `parse_jsonl` shall be unchanged. ADR-008 shall record the additive policy and its relationship with ADR-001 and R12.
req_statements.R7: `TokenAlternative`, `TokenLogprob` and `TaskKL` shall be exported from `quantdelta.core` and pinned by the public API snapshot; the `Scorer` signature change shall be pinned too. The core shall add no runtime dependency and shall keep its import boundary (no httpx, no I/O, no adapter vocabulary).
req_statements.R8: Every invalid value shall raise `InvalidDataError` naming the offending field (or `<root>` only when no single field applies). At minimum: NaN/Inf/positive log-probabilities, empty tokens, duplicate alternative tokens, masses outside `[0, 1]`, negative or non-finite KL, duplicate `TaskKL` ids, a `TaskKL` id absent from `deltas`, a KL mean mismatch, and a partial KL field set. Tests shall cover each rule, the old-report compatibility, the new round-trip, the port signature and the public exports.
